text: Data will be generated at each of our institutional sites. The PI at each institution will be responsible for following the data management guidelines described below, and for saving the data to the RIC servers.
label: answer.text

text: This process of transferring all data to a central location will be facilitated by our research project coordinator.
label: answer.text

text: Our data management guidelines will be reviewed at the kickoff meeting for the project, and revisited briefly at each of our quarterly meetings with the PIs.
label: answer.text

text: ** Types of data **
label: section.title

text: ** The Data Management Plan should describe the types of data, samples, physical **
label: question.text

text: ** collections, software, curriculum materials, or other materials to be produced in the course **
label: question.text

text: ** of the project. It should then describe the expected types of data to be retained and shared, **
label: question.text

text: ** and the plans for doing so. The DMP should cover how data are to be managed and **
label: question.text

text: ** maintained during the project. **
label: question.text

text: We will manage all scientific and technical content generated from this proposal.
label: answer.text

text: Our products will include 3 broad types of data.
label: answer.text

text: First, we will have data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the experimental code used to collect those data.
label: answer.text

text: The relevant code will include both the data acquisition code, and the code for the controllers used in the experiment.
label: answer.text

text: Together, this information will be sufficient for recreating the circumstances of each data collection session.
label: answer.text

text: Our second type of data will be the code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data.
label: answer.text

text: Specifically, we store all code necessary to recreate figures, tables, and other results reported in all published manuscripts.
label: answer.text

text: The proposed foundational developments will produce substantial simulation code for controller development and testing.
label: answer.text

text: These and the outputs relevant to all key findings will also be managed.
label: answer.text

text: ** Policies for access and sharing and appropriate protection and privacy **
label: section.title

text: ** The Data Management Plan should describe the period of time the data will be retained **
label: question.text

text: ** and shared; factors that limit the ability to manage and share data, e.g., legal and ethical **
label: question.text

text: ** restrictions on access to human subjects data; and provisions for appropriate protection of **
label: question.text

text: ** privacy, confidentiality, security, and intellectual property. **
label: question.text

text: Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study.
label: answer.text

text: The availability of data (raw and analyzed) will be advertised on the project’s website.
label: answer.text

text: Access will be free, but the original data collector/creator/principal investigator retains the right to use the data for analysis before making it publicly available.
label: answer.text

text: No patient identifying information will be included in any of the available data files.
label: answer.text

text: Select videos of the experiments will be distributed, with subject faces blurred so as to be unidentifiable.
label: answer.text

text: Experimental analyses results will be made available through peer-reviewed journal publications and conference presentations.
label: answer.text

text: The code needed to generate all published results will be documented clearly.
label: answer.text

text: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available for free download on the labs’ websites.
label: answer.text

text: This includes code for each of our 3 experimental systems.
label: answer.text

text: We commit to speaking with any qualified scientist who wishes to discuss our results or the technology employed to obtain our results.
label: answer.text

text: There will be no copyright or licensing required for any of the data generated in this project.
label: answer.text

text: Research records will be archived for a minimum of seven years after final reporting or publication of a project.
label: answer.text

text: If any questions regarding the research, including but not limited to research integrity allegations, are raised during the seven- year retention period, the PI will keep the records until such questions are fully resolved.
label: answer.text

text: ** Data storage and preservation of access **
label: section.title

text: ** The Data Management Plan should describe the mechanisms and formats for storing data **
label: question.text

text: ** and making them accessible to others, which may include third party facilities and **
label: question.text

text: ** repositories; and other types of information that would be maintained and shared regarding **
label: question.text

text: ** data, e.g. the means by which it was generated, detailed analytical and procedural **
label: question.text

text: ** information required to reproduce experimental results, and other metadata. **
label: question.text

text: The servers at the Rehabilitation Institute of Chicago will serve as the central repository for all collected data.
label: answer.text

text: Raw data files will be saved in either Matlab or comma-separated value (CSV) format.
label: answer.text

text: Code for converting between these formats will also be provided to ensure easy access.
label: answer.text

text: The contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used during generation will be documented.
label: answer.text

text: All raw data will be de-identified to ensure subject anonymity.
label: answer.text

text: Upon request, data will be made available through the project's website, hosted on an archived server run by the RIC IT Team.
label: answer.text
